answer: Make every identity pay a stake to enter: an agent locks a small refundable deposit and binds it to one verified vertex in a shared trust graph. Peers mirror each other's attestations, so the same behavior pattern showing up under many names exposes a cluster of fakes. If one identity in a cluster is caught cheating, the whole cluster loses its stake, making each fake expensive. Honest agents pay once and keep a haven for trade, while a sybil farmer must fund every copy separately.
